paite: Huchi in Shuah mi Bildad in adawng a, hichi in achi:
heading: Bildad Thugen Masa:
english: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

paite: "Bang tan hiai thilte gen ding na hia? Bang tan na kam a thute huih hat bang ding ahi ua?
english: “How long will you speak these things? Shall the words of your mouth be a mighty wind?

paite: Pathian in vaihawmna ahekkawi a hia? Ahihkeileh Bangkim hihthei in dikna ahekkawi ahia?
english: Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert righteousness?

paite: Atung ah na tate akhial ua, huai tatlekna ziak a akhut a amaute apikhiakleh,
english: If your children have sinned against him, He has delivered them into the hand of their disobedience.

paite: Pathian lam kuhkaltak a na zon a, huai Bangkim hihthei kiang a na thilnget na bawlleh;
english: If you want to seek God diligently, make your supplication to the Almighty.

paite: Na sianthou a na dikleh; nang ziak in tu in ka khanglou dia, na diktatna omna alohchingsak ding hi.
english: If you were pure and upright, surely now he would awaken for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness prosperous.

paite: Na kipatna neu mahleh, na tawpna nanung lam nakpi in athupi ding hi.
english: Though your beginning was small, yet your latter end would greatly increase.

paite: "Huaiziak in ka hon ngen hi, hun masa thu kan inla, apipute un ana zonkhiak uh lam ah kisuk in.
english: “Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.

paite: Ei lah zan a lel i hi ua, bangmah i thei kei uh, leitung ah i nite uh lah limliap ahi a.
english: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days on earth are a shadow.)

paite: Amaute'n nang ahon sinsak un, ahon hilh un, alungtang ua kipan in thute agen kei ding ua hia?
english: Shall they not teach you, tell you, and utter words out of their heart?

paite: Buannawi lou in phaiphek akhangkhe thei a hia? Tui lou in loupa akhangthei a hia?
english: “Can the papyrus grow up without mire? Can the rushes grow without water?

paite: Hing a om a, satpuk louh ahih lai in, loupa dangte ma in avuai nak hi.
english: While it is yet in its greenness, not cut down, it withers before any other reed.

paite: Huai bang mah in Pathian mangngilhte tengteng lampi ahi; Pathian limsakloumi lametna amangthang ding:
english: So are the paths of all who forget God. The hope of the godless man shall perish,

paite: Amuanna akitan ding a, akingakna maimomlen ahi hi.
english: Whose confidence shall break apart, Whose trust is a spider’s web.

paite: A-inn tung ah akingai dia, himahleh adingh kei ding; huai ah alen tinten ding a, himahleh apang sawt kei ding hi.
english: He shall lean on his house, but it shall not stand. He shall cling to it, but it shall not endure.

paite: "Nisuah ma in ahing a, ahuan ah aselte amengkhia uhi.
english: He is green before the sun. His shoots go forth over his garden.

paite: Azungte leivum kim ah azam ua, suangte omna mun ah ahing hi.
english: His roots are wrapped around the rock pile. He sees the place of stones.

paite: Amun a kipan lakmang hileh, huchi in amah akitheihmohbawl ding a, Ka hon mu ngei kei, chi in.
english: If he is destroyed from his place, then it shall deny him, saying, ‘I have not seen you.’

paite: Ngai in, hiai alampi kipahna ahi a, lei a kipan adangte ahong suak ding uh.
english: Behold, this is the joy of his way: out of the earth, others shall spring.

paite: Ngai in, Pathian in mihoihkim apaikhe kei ding, gilou hih mite leng atungding sam kei ding hi.
english: “Behold, God will not cast away a blameless man, neither will he uphold the evildoers.

paite: Na kam nuih in ahon dimsak lai dia, na mukte kikouna in.
english: He will still fill your mouth with laughter, your lips with shouting.

paite: Hon mudahte zumna in akhuh ding a; gilou puanin a-omta kei ding hi.”
english: Those who hate you shall be clothed with shame. The tent of the wicked shall be no more.”
